verdict.rationale: Stripe provides building blocks for unattended agent activity. Machine payments over MPP/x402 let agents pay for APIs programmatically without a checkout UI, and shared payment tokens with spend limits and expiry allow pre-scoped delegated spending. Webhooks for catalog imports, completed checkouts and token use support event-driven back-ends. However, it offers no first-party way to define or schedule background automations, and the Link CLI and MCP paths require human approval for each spend or sensitive write. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or scheduling feature, fully unattended background execution on the wallet and MCP paths, and hands-on evidence of autonomous runs.
